source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Instead of sending me the script first, prepare 16 sec shots so I can judge whether they work. They must be in Hindi, not english, because the script alone does not let me visualize how the result will look.

value_updates.review_purpose: allow the client to judge the visual execution before proceeding

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Nikhil Rao,

The first draft is attached for your review. It took a little longer than expected because I did not want to rush the work; both the visuals and voiceover needed to come together in an engaging, natural, and scroll-stopping way while remaining true to your reference style.

I also found that forcing the story into exactly 16 seconds made it feel rushed. To give the emotions, product reveal, and voiceover enough space, I extended the draft slightly to 22 seconds. I believe the added room creates a stronger, more natural viewing experience without losing the impact of a short-form ad.

Please share your feedback. I am happy to refine anything you would like changed, and I remain fully committed to making sure the final production satisfies you and achieves the outcome you envision.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports attaching a 22-second first-draft preview containing visuals and voiceover for client review.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Although I have seen the preview and it is acceptable enough to continue, it is still not truly up to the mark. Go ahead and prepare the full video. If you cannot find another direction, you may adapt the last reference for my product, but the result must be completely better than that reference.

execution.observed_behavior: The client reviewed the preview and authorized full-video production, while noting that the preview's creative quality remained below the desired standard.

routing_warnings.description: The complaint that the preview looks obviously AI-generated is a failure of visual realism rather than of the preview approval workflow.
The instruction to set independent creativity aside and adapt the last reference changes the creative concept direction.
The instruction to include both products changes the product-presentation Requirement.
